categories.name: AI Coding Editors & Agents
categories.headline: Best AI Coding Agents & Editors
categories.description: IDEs and terminal agents that write, refactor and ship code with you.
categories.intro: The best AI coding tool for most builders in 2026 is Cursor: an AI-first editor with a strong agent mode and a free plan to start. Pick Claude Code for large refactors and long-running terminal tasks, OpenAI Codex if you already pay for ChatGPT and want to hand tasks off to the cloud, and GitHub Copilot if your team lives in GitHub. Want free and open source? Use Cline or Aider with your own API key.

categories.intro: The best AI app builder for most people is Lovable: describe your app in chat and get a polished, full-stack web app with a free plan to try it. Bolt.new is the fastest way to spin up a full-stack prototype in the browser, v0 is best for React/Next.js UI that deploys to Vercel, and Replit is best if you want to build and host in one place. For internal tools with built-in auth and data, try Base44.

categories.description: Models and apps for generating and editing images.
categories.intro: The best AI image generator for raw aesthetics is Midjourney (paid only, from $10/mo). For images with readable text and step-by-step edits, use GPT Image in ChatGPT; for fast conversational editing, use Nano Banana in Gemini (both have free usage). Ideogram is the pick for logos and posters with typography, and Recraft for vector icons and brand-consistent assets.

Runway is best if you also need editing tools, Kling AI gives realistic motion at a lower price, and Luma Dream Machine is great for fast ideation and image-to-video. For playful social clips, use Pika.

categories.intro: The best AI agent framework for TypeScript and Next.js builders is the Vercel AI SDK; for Python, start with the OpenAI Agents SDK or Pydantic AI. Use the Claude Agent SDK to build agents that work with tools and files like Claude Code, and LangGraph when you need complex, stateful graphs with human-in-the-loop. All of these are free, open-source libraries; you pay only for model usage.
